result:
Nothing in the repo works end to end yet. The package prints a greeting, and there's no spec. So I'm staging this as a new project. I've taken the outcome candidates from your brief, `specs/ces-revisions-prompt.md`, and used the three research files only for facts and costs. I need one answer from you, at the bottom, before I write any roadmap text.

## Outcomes (unranked, all from `specs/ces-revisions-prompt.md`)

| # | Outcome | Cost (estimate; basis) |
|---|---|---|
| O1 | A real-time revision panel: total nonfarm and supersectors, NSA and SA, with first, second and third prints, preliminary and final benchmarks, and post-benchmark vintages | Small on disk: a few MB of monthly values across a few hundred vintages. FRED/ALFRED's published API limit is 120 requests per minute. NSA supersector vintage coverage is the open cost; Stage 1 measures it. |
| O2 | Revision magnitude over time for each of the four stages: dispersion and tails, by regime (pre/post-2003, 2020–22, 2025) | Negligible once O1 exists |
| O3 | A split of SA one- and two-month revisions into an NSA-sample part and a seasonal-factor part | Depends on how far back joint NSA/SA vintages go; only running it can tell |
| O4 | Collection-interval and closing-rate covariates (days from the 12th to first closing, first/second/third-closing rates) | Interval days are computed from the calendar. Closing-rate history must come from archived releases; I can't estimate the depth without fetching them. |
| O5 | Operational-capacity covariates: real appropriations, FTE, sample size, and shutdown/CR/sequestration dates | Your time. About 47 fiscal-year values per series (FY1980–FY2026), hand-built from budget justifications and FedScope. |
| O6 | Estimated effects of the covariates on revision scale, by stage, pooled across supersectors, with uncertainty about the "true" path | Compute unknown. The core stage measures the real fit time. |
| O7 | Validation of O6: posterior predictive checks on dispersion, LOO against a constant-variance baseline, and pseudo-real-time checks | Several refits for pseudo-real-time. Cost scales with O6's measured fit time. |

## Proposed tracks

- **A: Revision data and description (O1, O2).** Known progression. It answers "what happened to revision scale." It's also a usable product on its own, so it shouldn't wait on the model.
- **B: Seasonal vs. sample decomposition (O3).** Research. This question doesn't need the driver covariates at all. Bundled with C, it would wait on O4 to O7 for no reason.
- **C: Drivers of revision scale (O4–O7).** Research. The method and the answer are both open, and identification of the slow-moving covariates is uncertain.

Dependency: B and C both consume A's panel.

## Choices already made

- Python 3.14 (`.python-version`), managed with uv.
- NumPyro (NUTS), Dynamax, Blackjax only if needed, ArviZ, Polars (from the brief).
- The estimand is revision *scale*, so covariates enter the variance.

## Proposed name

`ces-revisions`, giving `specs/ces-revisions-roadmap.md`. No file by that name exists.

**Optional probe:** I can fetch one real ALFRED vintage listing (total nonfarm plus one NSA supersector series) to firm up O1's coverage note. This only gathers information, and I'll run it only if you say yes.

**Your call:** please rank the outcomes within each track and rank the three tracks against each other. Also confirm or change the tracks, their kinds, and the name. Add a yes or no on the probe if you like.
